positions.title: Science Team Summer Analyst
positions.description:
• Develop and assess text mining machine learning models using Python
• Write Python scripts to automate data collection, preprocessing, and web scraping
• Analyze operations to inform development and deployment of internal predictive analytics tools

positions.title: Analytics Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an internal website to host and distribute insights from a product analytics team
• Interviewed business development teams that used the website to understand their needs and optimize the site
• Analyzed large datasets and created reports to provide insight on HP's web printing business
• Wrote SQL queries to populate dashboards and workbooks with live data from HP's servers

positions.title: Operations Intern
positions.description:
•	Co-headed event planning and oversaw volunteer operations for a three day 80 person conference
•	Persuaded restaurants to provide approximately $4000 dollars in charitable food donations for conference
•	Consolidated and analyzed results of thousands of pre and post-program surveys to determine impact

positions.title: Campus Representative
positions.description:
